seed.title: User profile
seed.content:
- Applied AI engineer between Nantes and Abidjan.
- Prefers short answers.

seed.title: Trip to Abidjan
seed.content: - departure 8 December, return 20 December, hotel on the Plateau.

seed.title: DevFest talk
seed.content: - 40 minute talk on offline agents, slides due 1 December.

seed.title: Cache-aware memory research
seed.content: - measure cost and latency of harness caches.

seed.title: Pixel 4 XL tests
seed.content: - Termux, llama.cpp, pin to A55 cores for a low-end profile.

seed.title: Research funding
seed.content: - French Tech Emergence, i-Lab, CIFRE thesis.

seed.title: Half marathon plan
seed.content: - Nantes in April, under 1h50, long run on Sundays.

seed.title: Tax return
seed.content: - conference income as non commercial profits, keep travel receipts.

seed.title: Attieke recipe
seed.content: - grilled fish, onions, tomatoes, two hours of marinade.

seed.title: Developer community
seed.content: - GDG Cloud Abidjan meetups, speakers for the next season.

seed.title: Hiring an intern
seed.content: - Python and data, six months, start in February.

seed.title: Car maintenance
seed.content: - service due at 60000 km, winter tyres in November.

seed.title: Apartment move
seed.content: - lease ends in March, boxes, moving company quotes.

seed.title: Reading list
seed.content: - MemGPT, vLLM PagedAttention, LongMemEval, LoCoMo.

seed.title: Health check
seed.content: - annual check up booked, blood test fasting.

seed.title: Family visit
seed.content: - parents arriving in Nantes on 2 January for two weeks.

seed.title: Monthly budget
seed.content: - rent, savings goal 500 euros, cloud bill under 30 euros.

seed.title: Online course
seed.content: - distributed systems course, lecture 6 on consensus.

seed.title: Balcony garden
seed.content: - tomatoes and basil, water every two days in summer.

seed.title: Guitar practice
seed.content: - fingerpicking, 20 minutes a day, song for the wedding.

seed.title: Friend's wedding
seed.content: - Cotonou in June, best man speech, flights to book.

seed.title: Visa paperwork
seed.content: - e-visa for Cote d'Ivoire, passport valid until 2031.

seed.title: Cloud bill
seed.content: - BigQuery scans, set a budget alert at 20 euros.

seed.title: Paper draft
seed.content: - workshop deadline in January, related work section first.

seed.title: Patent filing
seed.content: - INPI provisional before any publication, 13 euros.

seed.title: Laptop upgrade
seed.content: - MacBook with 16 GB RAM, keep the M2 for tests.

seed.title: Learning Swahili
seed.content: - ten words a day, Akili and Urithi vocabulary.

seed.title: Newsletter
seed.content: - monthly issue on agent memory, 400 subscribers.

seed.title: Dentist
seed.content: - appointment on 14 November at 9 am.

seed.title: Birthday gift
seed.content: - sister's birthday on 30 November, a book and headphones.

seed.title: Conference CFP
seed.content: - submit to the cloud summit, abstract of 300 words.
